reason: Health/readiness probes must remain without authentication so external uptime checkers (k8s, k8s probes, blackbox-exporter) can hit /health without credentials. Liveness probes are NOT authorized by RBAC.

Login / refresh / logout / me endpoints cannot require authentication BEFORE they issue the JWT. They opt out of @Permissions via deliberate absence (the guard's no-metadata passthrough takes care of it).

Catalog bootstrap endpoint intentionally reads the permission catalog from Mongo without forcing the user to pre-declare a permission for the act of reading permissions (bootstrap dependency). Should add a 'system:read' gate in TZ-258 close-out.
System-level settings (org config, feature flags). Pre-TZ-255 these were gated only by @Roles('admin'). Should add 'system:read' / 'system:write' gates.
